subject: Commercial readiness — procurement pathing, SOC 2 / DPA asks
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@brightpath.com>, Procurement Team <procure@brightpath.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-20T09:13:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up & checklist from today — procurement routing + security gating

Hi Elena / Brightpath procurement team,

Great to meet earlier today — quick recap and the asks we agreed on to keep the deal moving. I’m copying Marissa (Customer Success) and Karthik (Commercial) to help coordinate procurement and security evidence.

Summary of what we covered:
- Commercial path options: card for a short pilot, purchase order (PO) for production, or route through Azure Marketplace (you mentioned interest).
- Primary procurement gating: SOC 2 Type II evidence, executed DPA, and completion of your security questionnaire.
- Timing / next steps: we want to align on which path you prefer and who on your side will own the PO vs. marketplace paperwork.

Immediate asks from Brightpath: (can you confirm by EOD Thu?)
1) Preferred commercial route: PO | Card | Marketplace (pick one)
2) Procurement contact (name, role, email) for PO routing or Marketplace onboarding
3) Estimated procurement timeline and any required vendor onboarding steps
4) If you want the security questionnaire filled by us, please attach it (we can return within 3 business days)

What we will provide:
- Redacted SOC 2 Type II report or SOC 2 interim evidence (depending on what you need)
- Our standard DPA (attached as a stub)
- Pre-filled security questionnaire where possible (we prefer to complete your XLSX directly)

I attached a short procurement checklist to make this easier (redwood-procurement-checklist.pdf). Once we know the commercial route we’ll route the right legal/finance contacts.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min call if that’s easier to walk procurement through.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood-procurement-checklist.pdf (stub)
From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@brightpath.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@brightpath.com>
Date: 2026-06-20T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & checklist from today — procurement routing + security gating

Ben — thanks for the recap and the checklist. Quick answers below and attaching our PO template and security questionnaire.

Answers:
- Commercial route: We want to pursue a PO for the initial production contract, but we can do a 30-day card-based pilot if it helps accelerate the timeline. Marketplace would be preferred longer term (Azure Marketplace) but that typically takes longer (vendor onboarding).
- Procurement contact: Maria Silva, Senior Procurement Manager — maria.silva@brightpath.com. She’ll own PO routing and signature.
- Estimated timeline: procurement team estimates 2–3 weeks to sign a PO (assuming SOC2 evidence and a completed questionnaire). Marketplace onboarding would be 6–8 weeks.
- Security questionnaire: attached (security-questionnaire.xlsx). Please fill the vendor-responses tab and return. Our vendor risk team requires completion before legal will approve the PO.

About SOC 2 / DPA:
- SOC 2: Brightpath requires Type II. We understand Redwood has SOC 2 Type II in progress — would you be able to provide interim reports or a bridge letter while the Type II is final?
- DPA: we need an executed DPA prior to signing. We can accept your standard DPA if legal signs it.

I’ve attached: brightpath-po-template.pdf (stub), security-questionnaire.xlsx (stub). I’ll loop Maria on the next email thread.

Thanks,
Elena
Director, Platform Partnerships — Brightpath Analytics
elena.ortiz@brightpath.com

Attachments: brightpath-po-template.pdf (stub); security-questionnaire.xlsx (stub)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@brightpath.com>, Maria Silva <maria.silva@brightpath.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-21T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & checklist from today — procurement routing + security gating

Elena / Maria — thanks for the fast turnaround and for attaching the questionnaire and PO template. Two quick clarifications and our proposed routing to keep the timeline tight: 

1) SOC 2 evidence: We can provide our most recent SOC 2 Type II report as soon as it’s cleared for sharing (redacted). If you need a bridge letter/interim controls report, our security team can produce a short attestation within 48 hours. Will that suffice for procurement?

2) DPA: I’ve attached our standard DPA (redwood-dpa-v3.pdf). If your legal prefers, we can sign your DPA as well. Either way, we’ll prioritize execution before PO signature.

3) Questionnaire: We’ll fill the vendor-responses tab in your spreadsheet and return a completed version within 3 business days. If Brightpath’s vendor risk team wants to jump on a 30-min Q&A instead of back-and-forth, Marissa can join to answer technical security questions.

4) Commercial path recommendation: To hit production quickly we suggest: card pilot this week (if you want to start evaluating), concurrently prepare the PO and route DPA/SOC 2 evidence so the PO can sign in ~2 weeks. If you want Marketplace, we can open that track in parallel but expect longer lead time.

Next steps (action owners):
- Maria (Brightpath): confirm PO recipient and upload the filled PO when ready.
- Elena: confirm whether you want us to sign Brightpath DPA or use ours.
- Ben: will send our DPA and SOC2 interim evidence, and return the completed questionnaire by Fri 6/24.
- Marissa: available for a vendor Q&A — propose Tues 6/23 10:00am PT if that works.

I’ll attach the DPA and flag Marissa for the Q&A.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-dpa-v3.pdf (stub)
From: Procurement Team <procure@brightpath.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@brightpath.com>
Date: 2026-06-22T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & checklist from today — procurement routing + security gating

Hi Ben / Elena,

Maria from Procurement here. Thanks — confirming receipt of the PO template and questionnaire. A couple of notes from vendor onboarding: 

- Please send the completed security-questionnaire.xlsx with any supporting docs (SOC excerpts, SOC bridge letter). Our vendor risk team triages within 5 business days once the questionnaire and SOC evidence are uploaded to our portal.
- We prefer to receive an executed DPA prior to issuing a PO. If Redwood can sign our DPA, upload to DocuSign and we’ll complete it within 3 business days.
- PO process: after vendor risk approves, finance issues a PO. Expect 2–3 week SLA from today assuming no material open items.

We’ve attached an example filled PO (brightpath-po-template.pdf) showing our required billing entity and remittance address. Please send Redwood’s PO billing info and W-9 (if US tax entity).

For speed, if you can accept card payment for an initial 30-day pilot we can expedite access today; otherwise we’ll kick off the PO track.

Thanks,
Maria Silva
Senior Procurement Manager — Brightpath Analytics
procure@brightpath.com
